name: uwrl
description: Universal Web Resilience Layer — a production-quality TypeScript library for browser application reliability through progressive enhancement and developer-controlled resilience mechanisms.

scripts.build:bundle: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const distIndex=path.join(__dirname,'dist/index.js'); const distDTS=path.join(__dirname,'dist/index.d.ts'); const bundleJS='// UWRL Bundle\n' + fs.readFileSync(distIndex,'utf8').replace(/export/g,'import * as uwrl from"./index"; export default uwrl;'); const bundleDTS='import * as uwrl from"./index";\nexport default uwrl;' + fs.readFileSync(distDTS,'utf8').replace(/export.*?;/g,';'); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'dist/bundle.js'),bundleJS); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'dist/bundle.d.ts'),bundleDTS); console.log('Bundle created: dist/bundle.js');"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const dist = path.join(__dirname, 'dist'); if (fs.existsSync(dist)) { fs.rmSync(dist, { recursive: true }); }"
